resume_instructions: Read CONTEXT.md at the repo root — it has the full architecture, invariants, data flow, bug history, dev workflow, and a line-number map of every important function.
The whole app is one file: index.html (single <script> block). Backend: GoogleAppsScript.gs. Reference catalog: exercise_master_list.html. Profile: personal_vitals.json.
Dev: `python3 -m http.server 8765` then open http://localhost:8765/index.html. Local and deployed use different localStorage (different origins).

committed_and_pushed: v1.3.0 custom workout builder + custom_workouts.json + auto-push (push buttons removed) + resolveDayId underscore fix
v1.3.1 pull no longer jumps to Day 1
uncommitted: CONTEXT.md (untracked — commit before relying on it)

open_bug.report: Deleting a custom workout does not remove it from the drive-synced copy / does not persist the deletion to custom_workouts.json via cloud sync.
open_bug.where: deleteCustomWorkout() (index.html ~2636) → pushCustomsToDrive(true) → syncCurrentDataToGDrive(silent,'custom_workouts'). NOT yet root-caused; user interrupted with memory request before fix landed.
suspects: pushCustomsToDrive(true) is silent fire-and-forget (hidden-iframe POST); a failed write (URL/key/deploy) never surfaces, so the deletion looks applied locally but is not on Drive.
getCustomWorkoutArray() reads workout_split_plan — confirm deleteCustomWorkout removed it from BOTH workout_split_plan AND the customworkout_indices/localStorage cache before the push.

handleCustomWorkoutsResponse() re-merges customs; verify it does not re-add a plan that was meant to be deleted (it filters to whatever is still in split_plan, which should be correct — but check edge case where a stale local cache is re-seeded on next load).

Apps Script redeploy: if the deployed doGet/doPost still runs old code (ignores target), writes may go to the wrong file. Use the 'Verify On Drive' button and DevTools Network (expect straight 200 JSON, NOT a 302→HTML sign-in redirect).
open_bug.note: User previously hit a broken sync caused by a WRONG `?key=` value in the saved /exec URL. The client does NOT send key; if the URL contains key=WRONG (or the script's MY_SECRET_KEY changed), every request returns {status:'unauthorized'}. MY_SECRET_KEY currently 'MYJEY'.

key_mechanics.single_active_day_lock: active_timer_<dayId> in localStorage gates editing; getActiveRunningDay() walks split plan.
key_mechanics.day_id_parsing: resolveDayId(id) matches real split_plan keys (handles custom ids with underscores). Do NOT reintroduce /(day[0-9]+)/.
key_mechanics.custom_flag: day.custom === true distinguishes custom plans (rendered with a delete button) from static Day 1-4.
key_mechanics.hydration: today's log -> white (user-edited); non-today log -> gray via setGrayValue().
key_mechanics.autosave: triggerAutoSave -> 600ms debounce -> saveSession; only fires when workout active; local save independent from cloud.

gotchas_learnt: Apps Script changes require REDeploy (Manage deployments -> New version) to the same /exec URL; save alone is not enough.
Hidden-iframe form POST is fire-and-forget: client cannot see success/failure. 'Verify On Drive' does a follow-up GET to detect problems.

302 redirect (to Google sign-in) with a large HTML body in DevTools = the /exec URL is hitting an auth wall (wrong key value in URL, or deployment access/scope not granted to Anyone). Both pull and push silently fail in that state while local save still works.
jsdom is installed at /var/folders/t_/dkx509097s3dbl3xhpfmdq980000gn/T/opencode (node_modules) — use it for headless DOM tests; force process.exit() since the app's setInterval keeps the loop alive.
